categories.main_business_segments: Healthcare Realty Trust Incorporated is a self-managed and self-administered real estate investment trust (REIT) that owns, leases, manages, acquires, finances, develops and redevelops income-producing real estate properties associated primarily with the delivery of outpatient healthcare services throughout the United States. The company's portfolio consists primarily of medical office buildings, inpatient facilities, and office properties, with medical office/outpatient facilities representing the largest segment at 91.6% of gross investments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company does not develop or manufacture products or services. Instead, it operates as a real estate owner and operator, utilizing property management, leasing, and real estate development methodologies. The company provides integrated services including leasing, property management, acquisition, financing, development and redevelopment of healthcare real estate properties. It employs property management systems, asset management platforms, and real estate development expertise to maintain and enhance its portfolio.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are healthcare providers, physicians, and health systems that lease space in its properties. Key customer types include physician practices, surgery centers, imaging facilities, cancer centers, and diagnostic centers representing over 30 physician specialties. The company serves healthcare systems and providers across the United States, with significant concentrations in Dallas, Texas (9.2%), Houston, Texas (5.6%), and Seattle, Washington (5.0%) markets. The company had no single tenant accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenues as of December 31, 2022.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates throughout the United States with a diversified geographic portfolio. As of December 31, 2022, the company had gross investments of approximately $14.1 billion across 688 real estate properties distributed nationwide. Major markets include Dallas, Houston, Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Denver, Atlanta, Raleigh, and other metropolitan areas. The company also holds properties in California (11.1% of total revenue) and maintains a weighted average ownership interest of approximately 48% in 33 real estate properties held in joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the healthcare real estate supply chain, serving as a property owner and lessor to healthcare providers and practitioners. The company does not manufacture products or provide direct healthcare services but rather provides the physical infrastructure (real estate) that enables healthcare delivery. The company's position is that of a real estate owner and operator serving healthcare tenants and operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on generating stable, growing income and lowering the long-term risk profile of its portfolio by focusing on facilities primarily located on or near the campuses of acute care hospitals associated with leading health systems. Key strategic priorities include: acquiring and developing medical office buildings in high-growth markets with broad tenant diversification; maintaining properties on or near hospital campuses; implementing development and redevelopment projects; managing a balanced lease portfolio with fixed and CPI-based escalators; and integrating the 2022 merger with Healthcare Trust of America. The company emphasizes ESG principles including sustainability, environmental stewardship, and stakeholder engagement.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through rental income from non-cancelable operating leases with healthcare tenants. Rental income is recognized on a straight-line basis over the lease term. The company also generates revenue from operating expense recoveries (reimbursements for building-specific operating expenses), interest income from financing receivables, and other operating income including transient parking and management fees. As of December 31, 2022, rental income represented the substantial majority of the company's revenues, with the company's leases having weighted average remaining terms of approximately 4.5 years.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes for acquisition and development of real estate properties with private investors, healthcare providers, other REITs, real estate partnerships and financial institutions. The company is a large accelerated filer and publicly traded REIT on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker symbol 'HR'. The company had a market capitalization of approximately $6.4 billion as of June 30, 2022. The company's competitive position is strengthened by its focus on properties on or near hospital campuses, diversified tenant base, and integrated service offerings including leasing, management, and development capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Healthcare Realty Trust is a large-cap REIT with gross investments of approximately $14.1 billion as of December 31, 2022, comprising 688 real estate properties and 40.3 million square feet. For the year ended December 31, 2022, the company reported rental income of $907.5 million (up 74.4% from $520.3 million in 2021), net income attributable to common stockholders of $40.9 million, and FFO per share of $1.17. The company completed a significant merger with Healthcare Trust of America on July 20, 2022, substantially increasing its scale. The company had approximately 380.8 million shares outstanding as of February 24, 2023, and outstanding indebtedness of approximately $5.7 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's value proposition centers on providing high-quality, well-located medical office properties that enable healthcare providers to deliver effective patient care. Key differentiators include: strategic focus on properties on or near hospital campuses associated with leading health systems; diversified tenant base across over 30 physician specialties reducing concentration risk; integrated service offerings combining leasing, management, acquisition, financing, and development expertise; strong occupancy rates (87.8% as of December 31, 2022); contractual rent escalators averaging 2.77% annually; and commitment to ESG principles and stakeholder value creation. The company emphasizes being a preferred provider of medical office properties through operational excellence and long-term partnerships with healthcare systems.
